blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Undefeated Filipino boxer Carl Jammes Martin will face Mexican bet David Picasso on Saturday in the “Mexico vs. The World” boxing event in Riyadh. The 27-year-old southpaw from Ifugao is undefeated at 28-0 with 21 knockouts. Ranked No. 1 by the WBO at super bantamweight, Martin has moved up to featherweight to face Picasso in a chance to test himself against elite competition.
